description_expanded: This beautiful vacation rental home is conveniently located across the street from ZUMA Wellness center and the many amenities offered there. The home offers abundant natural light throughout. The main house includes generous dining and living areas, with the kitchen conveniently positioned adjacent to the dining room. The first bedroom is found at the first staircase landing and includes a queen bed with an ensuite bathroom. On the upper level, the primary bedroom with ensuite bath is appointed with a king-sized bed. A set of bunk beds (1 upper, 1 lower) is found in an alcove just outside the primary bedroom. The courtyard features both open-air seating and a covered section equipped with a grill and television for leisure. A third bedroom, located above the garage, also provides a king bed with an ensuite bathroom. Parking for this home is located in a one-car garage and a reserved space directly in front of the property. Guests staying in Alys Beach vacation rental properties enjoy personalized concierge services, exclusive access to the Caliza Pool and Restaurant, ZUMA Wellness Center and Café, advance access to purchase tickets to many of our signature events, a stunning new racquet sports venue, and private beach access. Each property includes Wifi, cable TV, YOLO coffee, kitchen supplies and 24-hour security included with the Resort Fee. An interactive vacation rental guest portal will be available to you and your guests to further help you plan your best vacation experience at Alys Beach. Beach chair set ups, beach food and beverage delivery, bicycle rentals, water sports equipment, private signature experiences and family portrait photography sessions (through our Preferred Photographer program) are also available at additional costs – our concierge will be happy to make recommendations.
